title: Colognes That Attract Women: This Month’s New Arrivals Worth Trying
summary: Looking for colognes that attract women? This month's new arrivals lean warm and spice-forward, with three new fall gourmands for her worth knowing.
body_markdown:
As we mentioned in a recent article,[the sexiest perfume isn’t necessarily the loudest one](https://www.scentbird.com/blog/sexiest-perfume-for-women-2026/) . If we were to look at it from a woman’s perspective, on the other hand, the same rules seem to apply. Women don’t want something too aggressive the moment a date enters the room. The colognes that attract women most reliably tend to lean warm and skin-close, spice, musk, amber.


This month’s new arrivals lean hard into that idea, three unisex takes on warm spice from Commodity and a clean, confident signature from TUMI. We’ve also got two new arrivals worth knowing for women, since a good new drop shouldn’t only run in one direction.


## Colognes that attract women: October picks


### [COMMODITY Spice+ Bold](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/commodity-spice+-bold-25039893111513)


A decadent double dose of spice. Saffron, allspice, and cinnamon sugar build real heat, then safraleine pushes it further, a warmth that sticks around well past sundown. Best for: anyone who wants real presence on a night out.


### [COMMODITY Spice- Personal](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/commodity-spice-personal-115425767309967)


The quieter sibling. The same saffron, allspice, and cinnamon sugar blend with skin musks instead, for a soft, warm cloud rather than a statement. Best for: everyday wear, more of a skin scent rather than cologne.


### [COMMODITY Spice Expressive](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/commodity-spice-expressive-239998772513475)


The most layered of the three, built to feel like wandering through a spice market. Saffron and allspice are combined with nutmeg, clove, and cardamom, melting into cinnamon sugar for a warm, chai-like blend. Best for: anyone who wants spice with real complexity.


### [TUMI Nova](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/tumi-nova-272927327499761)


A cleaner, more polished take on what makes a cologne magnetic, this scent opens with saffron and rose, before leather, amber, and vetiver settle into a refined, lasting base. Best for: date nights or any setting where understated actually reads as more attractive than loud.


## And for her: new arrivals worth knowing


### [JULIETTE HAS A GUN Banana Rush](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/juliette-has-a-gun-banana-rush-65849146887685)


This perfume takes the gourmand trend somewhere more playful.[Ripe banana](https://www.scentbird.com/blog/banana-matcha-marshmallow-perfume-gourmand-fragrances/) and maple syrup open things up, moving into creamy coconut and frangipani, before vanilla and sandalwood settle it into a warm, sensual finish, elegant rather than loud.


### [TWILIGHT X SCENTBIRD New Moon](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/twilight-x-scentbird-new-moon-3459762932549)


This one goes moodier, making it perfect for October. Ginger flower and Tahitian vanilla flicker against a base of warm caramel, glowing amber, and rich sandalwood, built for devotion rather than attention-seeking.


### [VICTORIA’S SECRET Bare Sueded Vanilla](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/victoria-s-secret-bare-sueded-vanilla-267904168148129)


The coziest of the three. Wild saffron opens with an earthy floral warmth, creamy sandalwood and spiced woods fill the heart, and a lush, milky vanilla suede settles into clean musks at the base, comforting and sensual at once.

## Frequently asked questions


### What colognes attract women the most?


Warm, skin-close scents tend to read better up close than loud, aggressive ones. Spice, musk, and amber, like in Commodity’s Spice line or Tumi Nova, create presence without overwhelming, which tends to work better in close settings like a date.


### What’s new this month for women’s perfume?


October’s new arrivals include Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush, a playful gourmand built on banana and maple syrup; Twilight x Scentbird New Moon, a floral amber tied to the Twilight Saga’s second film; and Victoria’s Secret Bare Sueded Vanilla, a cozy vanilla-suede scent.


### What’s the difference between Commodity’s three Spice fragrances?


All three share the same saffron, allspice, and cinnamon sugar base. Spice+ Bold intensifies it with safraleine for a louder, longer-lasting scent. Spice- Personal softens it with skin musks for an everyday, close-to-skin wear. Spice Expressive adds nutmeg, clove, and cardamom for a more layered, chai-like blend.
